title: Component structure
instructions:
## Purpose
Review how WorkspacePage composes the Review UI through local components and external component boundaries.

## Regeneration
Run from the scope root:

```sh
node "<generator-directory>/run.js" \
  --base "." \
  --exclude-component "external:@base-ui/react#*" \
  --exclude-component "external:lucide-react#*" \
  --root "WorkspacePage" \
  "src/client" \
  "src/shared/react-flow" \
  "src/shared/react-ui"
```
